note: States only that Comoros has no national asylum system and a UNHCR mission recommended referral pathways; no registration, document or digital-service statement for Comoros.

facts.fact: UNHCR SAMCO's monthly statistical report, sourced to the UNHCR Joint Registration Exercise, lists Comoros as country of asylum with 17 asylum-seekers and 7 refugees, 24 in total, as of 30 November 2025.

note: Nothing on refugees or displaced people in the Comoros; the South Africa item is a link.
